title: The Postcard of Bellbird Bay
author: Astrid Ishikawa
blurb: Lior Coldharbour, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
